finding.title: Open Redirect via Weak Allowlist Check
finding.description:
The isRedirectAllowed function uses String.includes() to validate redirect URLs against an allowlist, which can be bypassed by appending the allowed URL as a substring of a malicious domain.
Scout rationale and verification strategy: Line 136 checks url.includes(allowedUrl), so a URL like 'https://github.com/juice-shop/juice-shop.evil.com' would pass validation because it contains the allowed string as a substring. This allows redirecting users to attacker-controlled domains. Verification: call the redirect endpoint with a URL that contains an allowlisted string as a substring of a different domain.

observations.title: Open Redirect via Weak Allowlist Check
observations.description: The isRedirectAllowed function uses String.includes() to validate redirect URLs against an allowlist, which can be bypassed by appending the allowed URL as a substring of a malicious domain.
observations.rationale: Line 136 checks url.includes(allowedUrl), so a URL like 'https://github.com/juice-shop/juice-shop.evil.com' would pass validation because it contains the allowed string as a substring. This allows redirecting users to attacker-controlled domains. Verification: call the redirect endpoint with a URL that contains an allowlisted string as a substring of a different domain.

analysis_summary: The finding identifies a classic open-redirect vulnerability pattern in lib/insecurity.ts (lines 133-139). The isRedirectAllowed function uses String.includes() to validate user-supplied URLs against an allowlist, which is a well-known anti-pattern. A URL like 'https://github.com/juice-shop/juice-shop.evil.com' would pass validation because it contains the allowlisted string 'https://github.com/juice-shop/juice-shop' as a substring. FACTS: (1) The code at line 136 uses url.includes(allowedUrl) — confirmed by source metadata with matching SHA256. (2) The function is exported, indicating it is consumed by other modules. (3) The service is publicly exposed on the internet with high criticality and direct database access. (4) Authentication is mixed, meaning some endpoints may be accessible without full authentication. ASSUMPTIONS (not yet verified): (1) isRedirectAllowed is called within a route handler that performs an actual HTTP redirect (e.g., res.redirect(url)). (2) The redirect endpoint is reachable with the crafted URL. (3) No additional downstream validation prevents the bypass. The source metadata evidence from step 1 confirmed the file and line exist but was inconclusive on exploitability. The next verification step should locate the call site of isRedirectAllowed to confirm it gates a server-side redirect response.
